name: Price
summary: Commerce price primitive with current price, compare-at price, unit price, and sale visual treatment.

anatomy.name: compare
anatomy.description: Original or compare-at price shown when discounted.

anatomy.name: unit
anatomy.description: Optional unit or recurring price qualifier.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive display state. Sale treatment is a variant, not a duplicated state.

behavior.name: moneyFormatting
behavior.description: Targets provide already-formatted locale, currency, compare-at, and unit-price strings while preserving the price anatomy.

behavior.name: openTypeFeatures
behavior.description: Price exposes independent OpenType feature switches. Unsupported features are ignored by the active font without changing content semantics.

properties.name: currentPrice
properties.description: Already-formatted current payable price supplied by the target.

properties.name: compareAtPrice
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the compare-at element when no formatted value is supplied.
properties.description: Optional already-formatted original or compare-at price used with the on-sale variant.

properties.name: unitPrice
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the unit-price element when no formatted value is supplied.
properties.description: Optional already-formatted unit or recurring price qualifier.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Price presentation selected from the canonical variant list; default is the classless contract variant.

properties.name: accessibleLabel
properties.unsetBehavior: Use the visible price text as the accessible content when no aggregate label is supplied.
properties.description: Optional localized aggregate label that explains sale and compare-at meaning without relying on strikethrough.

properties.name: alternateDigits
properties.description: Enables the active font's ss01 stylistic set; in Inter this provides alternate open digits.

properties.name: slashedZero
properties.description: Enables the standard zero OpenType feature for a slashed zero when supported.

properties.name: tabularNumbers
properties.description: Enables tabular numeric widths to keep changing and aligned prices stable.

properties.name: contextualAlternates
properties.description: Enables contextual alternates when supported by the active font.

properties.name: fractions
properties.description: Enables automatic fractions for price content that intentionally contains fraction notation.

accessibility: Expose the payable price in text, not only visually.
Make discounted pricing understandable to assistive technology with clear text or aria-labels.
Do not rely on strikethrough alone to explain compare-at pricing.
Preserve locale and currency formatting for the target market.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition in components/css/primitives.css; targets provide formatted string content.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid formats prices with Shopify money filters and renders the canonical root variant and element classes.
